english: To raise awareness of research ethics among university members, the online course 『2026학년도 2학기 대학원생 연구윤리』 (Research Ethics for Graduate Students, 2nd Semester 2026) will be offered as described below. Graduate students and BK21 participating graduate students (graduate students funded by the BK21 government research program) are strongly encouraged to take the course.
- 2026-2) 대학원생을 위한 연구윤리(인문사회계/이공계) (Research Ethics for Graduate Students (Humanities and Social Sciences / Science and Engineering))
- 2026-2) Research ethics for graduate students(Humanities and Social Sciences/Science and Engineering)
B. Who should take the course
- New graduate students entering in the 2nd semester of 2026
- Current students who have not yet completed a research ethics course or the online training
C. Course period: 1 Sep 2026 (Tue) – 30 Sep 2026 (Wed) ※ BK21 participating graduate students may take the course until December 2026
D. How to take the course

- Log in to eTL (SNU's online learning system, http://etl.snu.ac.kr) → click 'SNUON-강좌목록' (SNUON Course List) on the left → search for '연구윤리 / ethics' → register for the course that matches your field → take the course (takes about 2 hours)
※ Completion is recognised only when you watch 100% of all videos and view the learning materials. After completing the course, you can print a certificate of completion.
Attachment: Guide to the 2026 2nd Semester Research Ethics Training for Graduate Students (Korean/English), 1 copy each.
